root_cause.text: In usbtmc_release(), pending anchored URBs were not flushed or killed before freeing associated driver data, allowing a use-after-free when the USB host controller driver completes a URB after the release path has freed the resources.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds a call to `usbtmc_draw_down(file_data)` in `usbtmc_release()` to flush anchored URBs, and the commit message explicitly states: "pending anchored URBs must be flushed or killed to prevent use-after-free errors (e.g. in the HCD giveback path)." The fix addresses a regression introduced by commit 4f3c8d6eddc2 ("usb: usbtmc: Support Read Status Byte with SRQ per file").
